rules.text: Establish bias and mark key levels
rules.detail: Set daily bias on the daily/4H chart, then mark PDH/PDL or key session levels.
Wait for a Judas-style sweep of the liquidity level opposite your bias.
Wait for a Market Structure Shift on a lower timeframe (5m/3m/1m), with genuine displacement.
Mark the FVG, order block, IFVG, or breaker left behind by the displacement leg, confirming premium/discount alignment.

rules.text: Enter on the retrace, tight stop
rules.detail: Limit order at the FVG, stop just beyond the sweep wick.
Target the opposite liquidity pool for a minimum 1:3 risk-to-reward.
At 10:00 ET (or 14:00 ET) mark the high and low of the previous 30 minutes.
Inside the window, the first side of the range that trades through sets the direction.

rules.text: Find the first FVG against the sweep
rules.detail: The first fair value gap after the sweep, in the opposite direction, at least 1 point wide.

rules.text: Enter at the near edge of the gap
rules.detail: Limit order at the edge of the FVG closest to price; cancel at the end of the window.
Stop 1 point beyond the sweep extreme; skip if more than 20 points.

rules.text: Target the other side of the range
rules.detail: Target the opposite side of the reference range; skip if under 10 points.

rules.text: Manage and stop for the day
rules.detail: One trade per window; close by 12:00 (AM) or 15:55 (PM); stop after two losses.
Wait for sweep of session or daily high/lows.

rules.text: Confirm the sweep is quick, not stalling
rules.detail: The sweep should be quick, with no stalling.
Look for the formation of SMT divergence.
Mark the IFVG, which should be at least 5 points in size.

rules.text: Wait for a close outside the IFVG
rules.detail: Wait for a candle to close outside the IFVG before entering.
Target is the opposite swing low.
NQ for volatility, ES for stability.

rules.text: Mark PDH and PDL before the open
rules.detail: Mark the recent and nearby highs and lows in price before the New York session begins.
The New York session starts at 09:30 EST — wait for the first 5-minute candle to form and mark its high and low.
Enter as soon as the next candle breaks and sustains above (or below) the 5m Opening Range.
Target is the next draw on liquidity, or the highs and lows marked before the market open.
Stop loss is no more than 15-20 points.
Identify and mark 15m FVGs.
Identify if price is in one-sided continuation or approaching a higher-timeframe key level.
Wait for price to touch the FVG and react.
In case of continuation, you want to see a quick reaction.

rules.text: Reversal: expect an impulse the other way
rules.detail: In case of reversal, you want to see an impulse move to the opposite side.
Enter after confirmation, using market structure shift or CHoCH and SMT with correlated pairs.
Target should be the opposite draw on liquidity.
